title: 第575章 昭华能舍弃众生，但我不能！
content_zh:
昭华天域，仙盟。

万道霞光自九天垂落，将整座洞天映照得如同琉璃般璀璨夺目。诸山巍峨，众水澄澈，一派祥瑞纷呈之象。

而此时，其主殿中，气氛却异常沉重压抑。

殿中十四道身影分列而坐，每一位周身皆有先天清气萦绕，赫然尽是炼就先天法身的道尊级人物。

他们是昭华天六大洞天、九大福地

从红色方下塔旁的墙壁处，猪妹Q技能越墙抗塔，加里奥跟闪，紧随其后。

李慕白反问道，刚才与之交手，在水下血甲巨鳄的灵活性很大，自己反而处处受限。

特别是现代一些知识可是互通的，云安先是咳嗽了一声，这下其他人都是看向他。

因为不论是骑拉帝纳还是黑暗洛奇亚，这一次出现都还像比上一次出现实力有了个突飞勐进的进步。

平儿姐姐说，那边桌子、椅子都是现成的，明个儿一早就安排人去铺设，不用姑娘费一点儿心。

躺在赤牙腿上的林琅天深吸一口气，脸上浮现出密密麻麻的鳞片，遮蔽了他原本的样貌。

这老哥脑洞大开，居然认为各类传说中的精灵就是三圣兽给他安排的考验内容，他的勇者之旅就是邂后一众传说中精灵的旅途。

“原来是这样呀，岸田哥哥很缺钱嘛，我看你身上穿的好像是范思哲品牌的衣服吧。”柯南略微好奇，按理说能穿得起这身衣服的，怎么也应该不至于太过贫穷，除非是那些没钱还爱慕虚荣的人。

房间的墙壁上，还张贴着他以前留下的几幅画报纸，不过颜色已经泛黄了。而旁边是妹妹贴上去的几张新画报，颜色还很鲜艳。

掌门大叔的脸有点扭曲，虽然这姑娘说的不无可能，但……这也说得太直了吧？瞅了瞅旁边的师妹已经冷了的脸，这种话真的适合说出来吗？真的适合吗？

说到这里，伸手朝对面那人一指，一道光芒射出，像是要攻击那人，但实际上，他这么做并不是攻击那人，而是在那人与自己之间，画出了一个奇怪的符号。

随即，我便重新转过身子，朝着尸妖厉鬼一步步的走了过去，能不能成事，就看我接下来的表现了。

拓拔莫三人不过有精锐千余，这位骨进大人拥精兵万人，可想他的势力有多大，就连和连也不敢轻易动他。

当大牛的车驶离石材厂时，我终于体会到了我和山子离开时，别人的那种心情，原来最内心最难受的，不是离开的人，而是送离开的人走的人。

而苏如意，也成功的格挡开了朝她奔袭而去的三把飞剑。看起来安然无恙的模样。

令狐白显然是比较在意李森的病情，她本意是进来安抚一番李森，然后想让李森多休息的。但是发现李森竟然跟自己攀谈了起来。

“听你如此说来，蚌族人似乎只想自保，并无与海族修士开战的意思？”李森问道。

“燕天王乃是燕族的族长，而在下则添居燕族的长老一职。”这名青发中年海族闻言，微微一笑。

因为以腐尸为养料的缘故，尸虫的身上积聚着大量的尸毒，一旦被其咬到，就算是武尊境界的强者也十分棘手。

洞穴天然形成，入口狭窄内部倒是极为宽阔，差不多能容纳十余人，是一个封闭的空间。

听到这里，刘晓玲心里一阵偷笑，这完全就是先前在派出所那里对那个所长说的原话嘛，而且还照着李宁册的话原封不动地还给了他。
content_en:
Zhaohua Tianyu, Immortal Alliance.

Thousands of rays of rays of light fall from the nine heavens, illuminating the entire cave sky as brightly as glass.The mountains are majestic and the water is clear, creating an auspicious scene.

At this time, the atmosphere in its main hall was extremely heavy and depressing.

There are fourteen figures sitting in a row in the hall, and each one has an innate Qi lingering around his body. They are all Taoist-level figures who have cultivated the innate Dharma body.

They are the six caves of Zhaohuatian and the nine blessed places.

From the wall next to the tower on the red side, Pig Girl's Q skill crosses the wall to resist the tower, and Galio follows closely behind.

Li Mubai asked in reply, he had just fought with him, and the blood-armored giant crocodile was very flexible under water, but he was limited everywhere.

Especially in modern times, some knowledge is interoperable. Yun An coughed first, and now everyone else looked at him.

Because whether it is Giratina or Dark Lugia, their appearance this time seems to have made rapid progress compared to the last time they appeared.

Sister Ping'er said that the tables and chairs over there are all ready-made, and someone will be arranged to lay them out early tomorrow morning, so the girl doesn't have to worry about it.

Lin Langtian, who was lying on Chiya's lap, took a deep breath, and dense scales appeared on his face, covering his original appearance.

This old man is so imaginative that he actually believes that all kinds of legendary elves are the test content arranged for him by the three holy beasts, and his journey as a brave man is the journey of meeting all the legendary elves.

"So that's it. Brother Kishida is very short of money. It seems to me that you are wearing clothes from the Versace brand." Conan was slightly curious. Logically speaking, those who can afford these clothes should not be too poor, unless they are those who have no money and are vain.

On the walls of the room, there are still several pictures of newspapers that he left behind, but the color has turned yellow.Next to it are some new pictorials posted by my sister, the colors are still very bright.

The head uncle's face was a little distorted. Although what the girl said was not impossible, but... wasn't it too straightforward?He glanced at the cold face of the junior sister next to him. Is this really appropriate to say this?Is it really suitable?

Having said this, he stretched out his hand and pointed at the person opposite, and a ray of light shot out, as if he was going to attack the person. But in fact, what he did was not attacking the person, but drawing a strange symbol between the person and himself.

Immediately, I turned around again and walked towards the corpse demon and ghost step by step. Whether I can succeed or not depends on my next performance.

The three of Tuoba Mo only have more than a thousand elite soldiers. Lord Gujin has tens of thousands of elite soldiers. You can imagine how powerful he is. Even He Lian does not dare to touch him easily.

When Daniel's car drove away from the stone factory, I finally realized the feelings of others when Shanzi and I left. It turns out that the most uncomfortable thing in my heart is not the person leaving, but the person sending the person leaving away.

Su Ruyi also successfully blocked the three flying swords that were heading towards her.Looks safe and sound.

Linghu Bai was obviously more concerned about Li Sen's condition. Her original intention was to come in to comfort Li Sen and then wanted Li Sen to rest more.But he found that Li Sen actually started talking to him.

"From what you said, it seems that the Beng tribe only wants to protect themselves and has no intention of starting a war with the Sea tribe monks?" Li Sen asked.

"King Yan Tian is the clan leader of the Yan clan, and I am the elder of the Yan clan." The green-haired middle-aged Hai clan man smiled slightly when he heard this.

Because it feeds on rotten corpses, a large amount of corpse poison accumulates on the bodies of corpse insects. Once bitten by them, it will be very difficult for even a strong person in the martial arts realm.

The cave is naturally formed. The entrance is narrow but the inside is extremely wide. It can accommodate almost ten people. It is a closed space.

Hearing this, Liu Xiaoling snickered in her heart. This was exactly what she said to the director at the police station, and she returned it to him exactly as Li Ningce said.
title_en: Chapter 575 Zhaohua can abandon all sentient beings, but I can’t!
